scope: 8 snowboard products; size specs inserted into seed YAML

sources.notes: Official product page provides effective edge, waist, tip/tail, sidecut, min/max stance, rider weight and boot-size ranges. Distances in source cm converted to mm for numeric mm fields.

Official table provides weight range, waist width, running length, radius, stance width, nose/tail width, and effective edge. Burton stance-location value is not mapped to setback because the unit/meaning is not explicit in the table.

sources.notes: Official page lists front/center/rear widths, sidecut radius, recommended stance, rider weight and height. Its body contains differing 50 mm and 35 mm setback descriptions; the per-size table leaves setback unspecified.

sources.modelSeason: Park & Ride 500 model page; 2026 seed identity
sources.notes: Official page lists width geometry, sidecut radius, recommended stance, standard 20 mm setback and nominal board weights. Nominal weights are 2710/2800/2848/3000 g, each with stated ±6% tolerance. The separate Powder Stance is 60 mm setback.
Official page lists width geometry, radius, recommended stance, 20 mm setback and nominal weights 2767/2670/2966 g (±6%).

sources.modelSeason: 2025/26 (2026 model; product page and full size table agree)
sources.notes: Complete standard and wide size table: effective edge, sidecut, nose/tail, waist, reference stance and rider weight. Values are retailer-published and are not tagged as direct manufacturer data. Sportano independently confirms the 2026 model and most geometry; its 163W effective edge differs by 3 mm, so the primary source values are retained throughout.

sources.notes: The exact 2024 product page identifies the model and publishes full geometry, reference stance and rider weight. Corrected shape to Directional Twin and removed unsupported zero-setback value. Existing slug remains unchanged for URL compatibility.

Official catalog section explicitly names DESPERADO micro/mini and includes effective edge, contact length, waist, nose/tail width, three-radius sidecut, stance range/setback, camber, and flex distribution. Lengths are 1320 and 1380 mm, represented as 132 and 138 cm.
